basis: Class I KNOX required for SAM formation and maintenance (STM); RNA in situ in shoot progenitor domes of tomato callus (Song et al. 2023 PNAS Fig 1G); DE in primordia clusters on 3 platforms (S1000 ii:1 0.15/0.008, Visium iii:1 0.31/0.07, snRNA iv:9 0.38/0.09). Conflict: also DE in snRNA "phloem-like" iv:3 (0.26/0.08), so require co-expression with GOB/CYP78A5. Song et al. 2026 Mol Plant: 10x Xenium places STM in the inner (plastic) compartment of the de novo stem-cell niche (symbol only; ID via the same lab's Song 2023 Dataset S3). Already high.

AP2 PLT3/5/7 (AIL6) class required for de novo shoot progenitor formation in callus (Arabidopsis; Kareem et al. 2015 Curr Biol); Song 2023 shoot_primordium module (Dataset S3) and DE in Visium iii:1 (0.34/0.06) and snRNA iv:9 (0.15/0.02). Single study in tomato callus; orthology from S3 only. Conflict: the same ID is a stem-cell-niche/root-cap marker in tomato root (Canto-Pastor 2024), consistent with PLT expression in all meristems. Song et al. 2026 Mol Plant: Xenium PLT3a marks the SCN inner compartment, but the panel has PLT3a and PLT3b and no IDs were accessible, so which paralog is "a" is unknown: not raised.

Second AIL6/PLT3-class AP2 gene in the Song 2023 shoot_primordium module (Dataset S3); DE in snRNA primordia iv:9 (0.20/0.03) only. Single study. Possibly the PLT3a or PLT3b of the Song et al. 2026 Mol Plant Xenium panel (inner SCN); paralog link unresolved, not raised.

P450 KLUH, characterized in tomato as fw3.2 (Chakrabarti et al. 2013 PNAS); Arabidopsis KLUH marks the SAM periphery. DE in primordia clusters on 3 platforms (S1000 ii:1 0.42/0.11, Visium iii:1 0.64/0.18, snRNA iv:9 0.39/0.07) but also Visium epidermis iii:10 and Stereo-seq inner callus i:0. Enrichment only, no in situ.

Proteinase inhibitor II family. The paper's SlPI51 in situ (Song 2023 Fig 4E) has no ID; this ID is inferred as the top DE gene of Stereo-seq i:5 (0.97/0.14), S1000 ii:1 and snRNA iv:9 (0.61/0.18). Stereo-seq i:5 also covers a medium-side surface band without meristem genes: use only with STM/GOB.

WUSCHEL homeodomain TF defines the organizing center (Mayer et al. 1998 Cell); in Song 2023 shoot_primordium module and shown in spatial maps (Fig 4J, S1G), but not DE in any cluster on any platform. Rare: find WUS+ cells by expression, not by cluster. Raised medium to high: Song et al. 2026 Mol Plant 10x Xenium (cell-resolution, independent sections and platform from Song 2023) localizes WUS to the SCN core (symbol only; ID via Song 2023 S3, UniProt A0A3Q7F7V4 xref Solyc02g083950). Caveat: WUS is also transient in air-side epidermis (WUS+ UEC state) and early wound/vascular zones, so require the core context (CLV3+).

Stem-cell peptide restricting WUS (CLV3); tomato SlCLV3 ID from Seo et al. 2024 (Solanaceae CLV signalling). Song 2023 shows SlCLV3 in a figure without an ID and it is not DE in any Song cluster. Rare. Raised medium to high: Song et al. 2026 Mol Plant 10x Xenium uses CLV3 as the SCN core-sublayer marker (Fig 2H; symbol only; UniProt K4DAJ5 gene CLV3 xref Solyc11g071380). De novo niche core, not a mature SAM CZ.

NAM/CUC2 NAC TF; tomato GOBLET is expressed at leaflet and organ boundaries and its mutants lack boundaries (Berger et al. 2009 Development); ID confirmed by Hendelman et al. 2013 and Song 2023 Dataset S3. DE in primordia S1000 ii:1 (0.19/0.03) and snRNA iv:9 (0.17/0.03). Conflict: Song figures label it SlCUC1, Dataset S3 maps it to CUC2/goblet. Song et al. 2026 Mol Plant: 10x Xenium CUC2 marks the SCN shell (peripheral) sublayer; the paper names it CUC2, supporting Dataset S3 over the 2023 figure label SlCUC1. Already high.

AP2/ERF TF required for auxin-triggered leaf initiation, expressed at incipient primordia (Capua & Eshed 2017 Development); in the Song 2023 shoot_primordium module (Dataset S3) but not DE in any Song cluster.

HD-ZIP IV MERISTEM L1 class (ITAG4.0) specifying L1/epidermis (Abe et al. 2003 Development); DE in snRNA air-side epidermis iv:5 (0.19/0.005; Song 2023) and claimed for epidermis in the seedling snRNA dotplot (Huang et al. 2026 Hortic Res), not validated in either. Whether it is the SlATML1 of the Song in situ is unknown (paper gives no ID). Song et al. 2026 Mol Plant: Xenium ATML1 marks the upper (air-side) epidermis (UEC); the ID link is by symbol and still unverified, so not raised.

Protodermal factor 1 domain protein (PDF1 is L1-specific in Arabidopsis); DE in air-side epidermis on 3 platforms (S1000 ii:4 0.36/0.06; Visium iii:10 0.90/0.15; snRNA iv:5 0.37/0.06; Song 2023). Spot-level spatial only. Being the paper's "SlPDF1" is inferred. Song et al. 2026 Mol Plant: PDF1 marks UEC in S3000 spatial (Fig 4G); ID link inferred, not raised.

Suberin feruloyl transferase; promoter:NLS-GFP exodermis-specific and CRISPR mutant loses suberin in tomato root (Canto-Pastor et al. 2024 Nat Plants); top DE of the unassigned snRNA callus cluster iv:21 (0.82/0.008; Song 2023). Validated in one study and cluster-specific in another: raised. Marks suberizing cells in any organ (root exodermis/endodermis, periderm, wound surfaces).

Long-chain acyl-CoA synthetase; CRISPR mutant loses root suberin (Canto-Pastor 2024); top DE of callus snRNA iv:21 (0.80/0.008; Song 2023). Function in one study and cluster-specific in another: medium raised to high. Not in UniProt; ITAG4.0 "Long chain acyl-CoA synthetase 5".
Suberin glycerol-3-phosphate acyltransferase; CRISPR loses suberin monomers (Canto-Pastor 2024); DE in callus snRNA iv:21 (0.53/0.002; Song 2023). Raised for agreement.
R2R3-MYB regulator of suberin; CRISPR mutants lose exodermal suberin (Canto-Pastor 2024); DE in callus snRNA iv:21 (0.25/0.000; Song 2023). Raised for agreement.

Acyltransferase; CRISPR reduces root suberin (Canto-Pastor 2024); DE in callus snRNA iv:21 (0.69/0.04) and air-side epidermis iv:5 (0.24/0.03), ii:4, iii:10 (Song 2023), and in the seedling cuticle-producing "exodermis-like" cluster (0.41/0.07; Huang 2026). Not raised: marks cutin-producing epidermis as well as suberizing cells.

Fatty-acid elongase for suberin/cutin monomers; exodermis-restricted in root scRNA (Canto-Pastor 2024), DE in callus snRNA iv:21 (0.37/0.016) and epidermis iv:5 (Song 2023), and in the seedling "exodermis-like" cluster (0.42/0.10; Huang 2026). Cross-study enrichment: low raised to medium. Also in cutin-producing epidermis.
Fatty acyl-CoA reductase; CRISPR changes suberin staining (Canto-Pastor 2024); DE in callus snRNA iv:21 (0.22/0.004; Song 2023). Agreement: low raised to medium.

GPI-anchored lipid transfer protein; exodermis-specific in root scRNA (Canto-Pastor 2024) and DE in callus snRNA iv:21 (0.67/0.003; Song 2023). Expression only, specific to the suberin lineage in two independent studies.

WOX4 maintains procambium/cambium (Hirakawa et al. 2010 Plant Cell); tomato wox4 CRISPR mutants fail vascular reconnection in grafts (Thomas et al. 2022 Plant Physiol, source of the ID). DE in snRNA procambium iv:6 (0.13/0.04; Song 2023) and S1000 ii:6. Weak enrichment. Song et al. 2026 Mol Plant: WOX4 (with CLE3) defines the procambium vascular subtype by spatial DE (Suppl Fig 5G); DE only and linked by symbol, so not raised.

TDIF receptor PXY/TDR, procambium-specific in Arabidopsis (Fisher & Turner 2007 Curr Biol); tomato ID from Thomas et al. 2022 (orthology not verified here). DE in snRNA procambium iv:6 (0.40/0.08; Song 2023). Song et al. 2026 Mol Plant: Xenium PXYa marks vascular/cambium-like callus origin cells (Fig 2C, 3A); PXYa/b paralog not resolved, not raised.
HD-ZIP III REVOLUTA class, provascular/adaxial identity; Song 2023 shoot_primordium module (S3 maps to REV). DE in snRNA procambium iv:6 (0.67/0.20), weaker in iv:10/14/16/20. Enrichment only.

HD-ZIP III (S3 maps to PHB); DE in snRNA procambium iv:6 (0.51/0.20) and primordia iv:9 (Song 2023); in seedling "xylem" hook clusters (0.26/0.10; Huang 2026). Enrichment only in both, so not raised; also xylem precursors.

Sieve element occlusion protein (SE-specific in Nicotiana; Ernst et al. 2012 Plant Cell); DE in the cell-resolution Stereo-seq vascular cluster i:4 (0.19/0.05) and snRNA phloem iv:15 (0.44/0.11; Song 2023), and top DE of the seedling hypocotyl "procambium" (=SE lineage) cluster (0.66/0.03; Huang 2026). Spatial in one, cluster-specific in another: medium raised to high. Developing (nucleate) SEs only in nuclei data. Not in UniProt; ITAG4.0 "Sieve element occlusion a".

SEO-B protein, SE-specific family (Ernst 2012); DE in Stereo-seq vascular i:4 (0.17/0.04), S1000 ii:2, Visium iii:4 and snRNA phloem iv:15 (top gene; Song 2023), and seedling SE-lineage cluster (0.55/0.01; Huang 2026). Raised for agreement.
Second SEO-B gene (ITAG4.0 "Sieve element occlusion b"); DE in Stereo-seq vascular i:4 (0.11/0.02) and snRNA phloem iv:15 (0.33/0.09; Song 2023). Single study.

Phloem protein 2-like lectin (PP2 family is companion-cell expressed); DE in Stereo-seq vascular i:4 (0.10/0.03) and snRNA phloem iv:8 (0.57/0.11) and iv:15 (Song 2023), and in the seedling SE-lineage cluster (0.52/0.04) and hook "cortex" (=phloem) cluster (Huang 2026). Low raised to medium. SE/CC complex, not one cell type.

MYB ALTERED PHLOEM DEVELOPMENT ortholog, phloem identity (Bonke et al. 2003 Nature); DE in snRNA phloem iv:8 (0.21/0.007; Song 2023). In tomato root it is listed as a phloem marker without validation (Kajala 2021; Canto-Pastor 2024). Not raised: no validation in any tomato study.

Uncharacterized heavy-metal-associated protein; DE in snRNA phloem iv:8 (0.83/0.13; Song 2023) and the seedling hypocotyl phloem cluster 10 and hook phloem-like cluster (0.61/0.05; Huang 2026). Expression only; cluster-specific in two studies.

Dof TF; Arabidopsis HCA2 is in phloem/interfascicular cambium (Guo et al. 2009 Plant Cell). DE in snRNA phloem iv:15 (0.42/0.06) and Visium iii:4 (Song 2023). Conflict: listed as Phloem by Huang 2026 (not in their DE table) and Procambium by Canto-Pastor 2024.

VND NAC master regulator of vessel SCW; overexpression in tomato roots gives ectopic SCW (Kajala et al. 2021 Cell); DE in snRNA xylem iv:19 (0.11/0.001; Song 2023). Function in one study, cluster-specific in another: medium raised to high. Low detection: use with CESAs.

Secondary-wall cellulose synthase; top DE of snRNA xylem iv:19 (0.87/0.08) and S1000 ii:8 (0.21/0.005; Song 2023); claimed in xylem dotplots of Huang 2026 and Canto-Pastor 2024 (not in their DE tables). Which CESA is not verified. Not raised: no validation.
Secondary-wall cellulose synthase; DE in snRNA xylem iv:19 (0.88/0.09) and S1000 ii:8 (0.51/0.02; Song 2023); listed for xylem by Huang 2026 and Canto-Pastor 2024. Paralog identity not verified.
Third secondary-wall-type cellulose synthase co-expressed with the two above: snRNA xylem iv:19 (0.85/0.09) and S1000 ii:8 (Song 2023). Single study; paralog identity not verified.

Papain-like xylem cysteine protease of tracheary element autolysis (Avci et al. 2008 Plant J); DE in snRNA xylem iv:19 (0.41/0.013; Song 2023); listed for xylem in Huang 2026 and Canto-Pastor 2024 without validation.
ITAG4.0 "Xylem cysteine proteinase 1"; TE autolysis protease; DE in snRNA xylem iv:19 (0.30/0.015; Song 2023). Single study.

NAC of the VND clade (orthology not verified); DE in snRNA xylem iv:19 (0.32/0.009; Song 2023); listed for hook xylem by Huang 2026 (not in their DE table). Not in UniProt; ITAG4.0 NAC domain protein.
UDP-xylose synthase for xylan in secondary walls; DE in snRNA xylem iv:19 (0.59/0.12) and S1000 ii:8 (0.35/0.03; Song 2023); listed by Huang 2026 (not in DE table).

Cinnamyl alcohol dehydrogenase (lignin); DE in snRNA xylem iv:19 (0.83/0.31) and S1000 ii:8 (Song 2023), and seedling hypocotyl xylem (0.35/0.07; Huang 2026). Enrichment in both but not specific (pct.2 0.31 in Song): not raised.

Light-harvesting antenna protein; Song 2023 photosynthesis module (Dataset S3) and DE in outgrowth-shoot clusters (Stereo-seq i:2 0.79/0.27, S1000 ii:9, Visium iii:7/11). Marks all green cells (shoot mesophyll and light-induced callus chlorenchyma); not a cell-type marker. Song et al. 2026 Mol Plant splits chlorenchyma into higher (HCC) and lower (LCC) cells by photosynthesis-gene level only, confirming this is an activity module, not an identity.

APC/C activator CDC20, G2/M; top DE of the unassigned snRNA callus cluster iv:18 (0.80/0.05; Song 2023) and of the seedling hook "phloem" cluster (0.29/0.05; Huang 2026). Canonical G2/M gene, specific in two independent datasets.
Mitotic B-type cyclin; DE in snRNA iv:18 (0.74/0.04) and iv:16 (Song 2023) and the seedling hook G2/M cluster (0.30/0.02; Huang 2026).
CDC20/Fizzy WD40; top DE of snRNA iv:18 (0.91/0.13; Song 2023). Single study.

Replication-coupled histone; DE in the unassigned snRNA callus cluster iv:20 (1.00/0.39, a histone-only S-phase cluster; Song 2023) and the seedling hook S-phase cluster (0.79/0.32; Huang 2026). Low raised to medium; not specific (high background).

Alcohol dehydrogenase, a hypoxia-induced gene; top DE of the medium-contact "Epidermis-like 2" S1000 ii:6 (0.95/0.41) and snRNA iv:1 (0.88/0.73; Song 2023). Broad background expression: a state flag for medium-contact cells, not an identity. Song et al. 2026 Mol Plant labels a hypoxic niche cell (HNC) state from GO, but 51% of HNC cells come from epfl8b/dcl2bd/pin2 mutant sections and no HNC genes are named in the accessible text; no new marker.

CLAVATA1 LRR-RK receptor of CLV3 restricting WUS in the SAM (Clark et al. 1997 Cell); Song et al. 2026 Mol Plant 10x Xenium places CLV1 in the inner SCN compartment of tomato callus (symbol only; ID from UniProt A0A3Q7GAM8, gene CLV1, xref Solyc04g081590). Not DE in any Song 2023 cluster. Single study.

Class IB LBD TF required for shoot-borne root initiation (Omary et al. 2022 Science). Validation: pSBRL:mScarlet-NLS in phloem-associated transition cells; sbrl CRISPR mutants lack shoot-borne roots (Omary 2022). From the characterization survey (characterized_markers.tsv; characterized in hypocotyl / stem, applies to organs regenerated on callus); not reported in Song 2023/2026.

Linalool synthase that makes monoterpenes in glandular trichomes (van Schie et al. 2007 Plant Mol Biol; Spyropoulou et al. 2014 Plant Mol Biol). Validation: promoter-reporter: the minimal TPS5 promoter is enough for glandular-trichome-specific expression in transgenic tomato; transcripts mostly in trichomes. From the characterization survey (characterized_markers.tsv; characterized in leaf, applies to organs regenerated on callus); not reported in Song 2023/2026.

EXPRESSION OF TERPENOIDS 1, a SHI/STY-family TF specific to glandular trichomes (Spyropoulou et al. 2014 Plant Mol Biol). Validation: glandular-trichome-specific expression; transactivates the TPS5 promoter. From the characterization survey (characterized_markers.tsv; characterized in leaf, applies to organs regenerated on callus); not reported in Song 2023/2026.

bHLH TF required for type VI glandular trichome formation and terpene biosynthesis (Xu et al. 2018 Plant Cell). Validation: knockdown gives smaller and fewer type VI glands, knockout abolishes them; regulates terpene synthases in gland cells. From the characterization survey (characterized_markers.tsv; characterized in leaf, applies to organs regenerated on callus); not reported in Song 2023/2026.

Neryl diphosphate synthase that supplies the monoterpene precursor in type VI glandular trichomes (Schilmiller et al. 2009 PNAS). Validation: 333-fold higher in isolated stem trichomes than in trichome-free stems (Fig. 2); abundant in a trichome cDNA library. From the characterization survey (characterized_markers.tsv; characterized in leaf, applies to organs regenerated on callus); not reported in Song 2023/2026.

Woolly HD-ZIP IV TF controlling multicellular trichome initiation and fate (Yang et al. 2011 PNAS; Wu et al. 2023 Dev Cell). Validation: gain-of-function alleles and RNAi alter type I/digitate trichome formation; Wo dosage specifies multicellular trichome types. From the characterization survey (characterized_markers.tsv; characterized in leaf, applies to organs regenerated on callus); not reported in Song 2023/2026.

Hair C2H2 zinc-finger protein that interacts with Woolly to initiate multicellular trichomes (Chang et al. 2018 Plant J). Validation: map-based cloning; deletion causes loss of type I trichomes; ectopic expression induces trichomes in tobacco. From the characterization survey (characterized_markers.tsv; characterized in leaf, applies to organs regenerated on callus); not reported in Song 2023/2026.
